tools.name: invoicesonline_get_business
tools.description: Get the id and name of the Invoices Online business this API login belongs to. Read only. Endpoint: getBusinessName.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_list_clients
tools.description: List every client of the business: name, contact, email, VAT number, addresses, active flag, balance and opening balance. Read only. Endpoint: getClients_JSON.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by client_id: contact details, active flag, current balance and opening balance. Read only. Endpoint: getClientDetails_JSON.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_find_client_id
tools.description: Look up the client_id from the invoice name, email and branch name. Read only. Endpoint: GetClientID.php. Returns the id, or the vendor's error text when no client matches.

tools.name: invoicesonline_get_client_history
tools.description: List a client's invoices, credit notes, pro-forma invoices, payments and payouts with totals and line items, plus the current and opening balance. Read only. Endpoint: getClientHistory_JSON.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_list_client_documents
tools.description: List one client's documents of one type (invoices, quotes, credit notes, jobcards, and so on). Read only. Endpoint: getDocumentsByType_JSON.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_list_suppliers
tools.description: List every supplier of the business with contact details, active flag, balance and opening balance. Read only. Endpoint: getSuppliers_JSON.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by supplier_id: contact details, active flag, balance and opening balance. Read only. Endpoint: getSupplierDetails_JSON.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_list_inventory_items
tools.description: List the inventory and stock items keyed by product code. Read only. Endpoint: InventoryItems.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_list_inventory_categories
tools.description: List the inventory categories keyed by category id. Read only. Endpoint: InventoryCategories.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_get_document_status_ids
tools.description: List the status ids and their names for one document type. Read only. Endpoint: getDocumentStatusIDs.php.

tools.name: invoicesonline_get_document_status
tools.description: Get the current status name and status id of one jobcard by its number. Read only. Endpoint: getDocumentStatus.php. Only jobcard is supported.

tools.name: invoicesonline_create_client
tools.description: Create a client in the business. Writes data. Only the invoice name and email are required. If the API finds a matching client, it returns that client's id and creates no duplicate. Endpoint: NewClient.php. Sends no email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoicesonline_list_clients, invoicesonline_find_client_id · Private data: invoicesonline_list_clients, invoicesonline_get_client, invoicesonline_list_client_documents, invoicesonline_list_suppliers, invoicesonline_get_supplier, invoicesonline_get_document_status_ids, invoicesonline_get_document_status · Public sink: invoicesonline_list_clients, invoicesonline_find_client_id, invoicesonline_create_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoicesonline_list_clients, invoicesonline_find_client_id · Private data: invoicesonline_list_clients, invoicesonline_get_client, invoicesonline_list_client_documents, invoicesonline_list_suppliers, invoicesonline_get_supplier, invoicesonline_get_document_status_ids, invoicesonline_get_document_status · Public sink: invoicesonline_list_clients, invoicesonline_find_client_id, invoicesonline_create_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
